title: Sourcing goods through Dubai
excerpt: Why buyers use a Dubai trading company to source goods, and what a clear supply brief should contain.
body:
Dubai is a practical base for companies that buy goods for resale or for their own operations. LAFA General Trading sources to a buyer’s specification, supplies on a wholesale basis, and arranges import into the United Arab Emirates and export to other markets.

A useful brief names the product, the pack if it is known, the quantity, and the destination market. Origin, brand preference, and a delivery window can be added when they matter. Availability and commercial terms are confirmed in the reply.

The catalogue lists food wholesale lines and general wholesale. Buyers who already know the product can open its page and enquire from there. Buyers who are still defining the requirement can start from a category, or from the contact form, and describe the goods in their own words.

title: What to include in a trade enquiry
excerpt: The details that let LAFA confirm availability: product, pack, volume, and market.
body:
A trade enquiry does not need to be long. It needs to be specific enough to check supply.

Include the product or category, the pack if you know it, the approximate volume, and the country or market the goods are for. If origin, brand preference, or a delivery window matters, say so. Prices are quoted in the reply. They are not listed on this site.

LAFA works with wholesalers, retail buyers, and hospitality procurement. The contact form is for business enquiries about supply.
